trigger: a pair whose newest retained row is ~1-2 MiB, then a sustained stream of refused frames to it
summary: Every refusal evaluates right(output, length($3)) on the pair's newest row: a full detoast (twice in a UTF-8 DB) of up to 2 MiB per refused frame even when the UPDATE is a no-op; bounded (<= 2 rewrites per pair, then CPU/transient memory per refused frame), not unbounded growth. Found independently by performance, sre (G8-SRE-2) and unhappy-path (UP-18).

Follow-up: skip the UPDATE on the no-op path (bounded in-memory marked set keyed (instruction_id, agent_id), same shape as cap_log_budget_, or a capped BOOLEAN column). Drafted; filed only on the owner's go.
